initial_measurement_note: Initial CLI harness had prepare-time host controls, exact output/empty-stderr/exit checks and pre/post executable digest equality, but did not compare digest to prepare receipt inside collect. This validator explicitly binds current binary to original receipt and verifies source/test files against released HEAD. No relevant controls were changed during collection; provenance remains retrospective. Raw original samples are retained. Timeout cleanup was hardened while the initial process was running; no timeout occurred.

frozen_source_archive.purpose: All later supplemental baseline builds use this archive, regardless of worktree edits.

measurement_overlap_note: Retrospective source hashing and git archive creation overlapped the running CLI baseline around this validation timestamp. This is extra host activity; samples remain untrimmed and are diagnostic, not an isolated acceptance gate.
